newsitem.title: FRANCE: SOCCER-BORDEAUX SLUMP TO FIRST DEFEAT IN 1997.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-BORDEAUX SLUMP TO FIRST DEFEAT IN 1997.

text.p: Montpellier handed Bordeaux their first defeat of the year with a 2-1 away victory in a French Cup quarterfinal on Saturday.
It was sweet revenge for Montpellier as they lost to Bordeaux in the League Cup semifinals last month after a nail-biting penalty shootout.
This time, the tie between two in-form sides -- Montpellier are unbeaten in their last 17 league matches -- was less hard-fought.
Bordeaux, who will play Strasbourg in the League Cup final on April 12, looked weary and, despite opening the scoring through Didier Tholot in the 14th minute, were dominated for much of the game.
It was unsurprising when former international Franck Sauzee equalised on a superb free kick two minutes before the break.
Kader Ferhaoui scored the winner in the 67th minute on a cross from Ivory Coast player Ibrahim Bakayoko, by far the best player on the pitch.
At 20, Bakayoko has already been compared to George Weah at the same age.
